dedupe_keys.name: chinese transmission embodied carbon matlab model

description: This MATLAB model calculates embodied-carbon emission intensities for electricity-transmission projects through multi-regional input-output analysis and estimates uncertainty using Monte Carlo simulation. The Chinese transmission-carbon research team provides a Figshare software release under CC BY 4.0 and a public GitHub mirror. The own README describes an example containing 41 transmission-line projects under 220 kV, which is narrower than the separate 191-project inventory associated with the study. Access to the archived code is free. Its geographic and temporal setting follows the Chinese 2015 accounting study and supplied project inputs, not a dynamic grid simulation. It can estimate construction-emissions consequences of network-expansion scenarios alongside topology resources such as data-re-europe. A caveat is that the repository description does not establish ready compatibility with later input-output tables or other countries. Monte Carlo results depend on the chosen input uncertainties. The archive was not downloaded and neither numerical outputs nor MATLAB dependency compatibility were tested.
